Multiple Road Accidents Across India Result in Fatalities and Injuries

Several road accidents involving trucks, buses, and pick-up vans have occurred across different Indian states, leading to multiple fatalities and injuries. Incidents reported in Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Madhya Pradesh, and West Bengal highlight the dangers of road travel. The accidents involved collisions with buses, overturning vehicles, and vehicles falling into ditches, resulting in the deaths of children and adults.
